// Sound scripts for Epic SWEPs. The wave files under sound/epic_sweps/ are
// generated by tools/make_sfx.py in this repo, so we can ship them. Everything
// else the addon plays is a path Valve already ships with Garry's Mod.
//
// Each sound also gets a numbered variant, which is how GMod picks a random one
// when you EmitSound the script name ("epic_sweps/explosion").
SoundScript
{
	"epic_sweps/explosion"
	{
		"channel" "1"		// CHAN_STATIC
		"volume" 1.0
		"level" 100
		"pitch" "96,106"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/explosion.wav"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/explosion_1.wav"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/explosion_2.wav"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/explosion_3.wav"
	}
}

SoundScript
{
	"epic_sweps/launch"
	{
		"channel" "1"
		"volume" 0.9
		"level" 90
		"pitch" "94,110"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/launch.wav"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/launch_1.wav"
		"wave" "epic_sweps/launch_2.wav"
	}
}

		"wave" "epic_sweps/siren.wav"
	}
}

// The voice lines. Text on screen is the fallback if these are missing, and the
// config points at the wav directly, so a broken script never silences the show.
SoundScript
{
	"epic_sweps/missiles_1"
	{
		"channel" "1"
		"volume" 1.0
		"level" 96
		"pitch" 100
		"wave" "epic_sweps/missiles_1.wav"
	}
}
